name: verification
description: 解析 test-plan.md 的两段式 checklist：`cmd:` 行为自动化测试（单元测试、接口测试、shell 验证），在 targetDir 中执行并比对 exit code；`human:` 行为功能测试（UI 交互、页面操作），展示给用户手动执行并确认。结果落入 verification.log；任一失败回到 Coding 重做，直到末尾出现 `ALL PASSED`。

prompt.instruction: Parse test-plan.md line by line. For every line matching '^- \[ \] cmd: (.+)$': run the captured command in targetDir, capture stdout/stderr and the exit code, and append a result line to verification.log using the format documented in verification_template.md. For every line matching '^- \[ \] human: (.+)$': do NOT execute; collect them into a 'Human checklist' block, present them to the user one-by-one, and record their pass/fail answer in verification.log. Group items by their parent '## G<N>.' heading; at the end of each group emit a group summary 'GROUP G<N> PASSED' or 'GROUP G<N> FAILED: <count> failing'. If every group passed, append a single final line 'ALL PASSED'. If any item failed, jump back to the Coding stage (state machine transition) and do not write 'ALL PASSED'.
guardrails: Never execute a `human:` line; only display it.
Run `cmd:` lines in the targetDir working directory; never sudo, never modify external paths.
Strip backticks and trailing punctuation from `cmd:` payloads before execution; preserve quoted shell strings as-is.
If a command exits non-zero or times out (>120s default per item), record [FAIL].
Do not write the final 'ALL PASSED' marker if any item is FAIL.
Truncate captured stderr per item to <= 200 chars in the log to keep the file readable; full output may be kept in a side file verification.full.log.
